project: Consumer #0 — eval-harness + AppealForge, the eval system as system under test
assumptions: [ASSUMED] AppealForge battery case files contain synthetic/de-identified PHI only; no real denial text is in the repo today.
[ASSUMED] AppealForge is currently gated by its own regression_gate (named in the adapter's 3-mirror comment), not by promote.py — the bundle cannot confirm which; IE-01 disambiguates on day one.
[ASSUMED] Battery composition ~14 happy / 4 edge / 4 adversarial known_bad / 3 benign controls, inferred from the report head and registry comments.
[ASSUMED] Pilot volume is low (<=100 letters/month), side-by-side on historical denials.
[ASSUMED] CI runs on GitHub Actions Linux; development happens on Windows (backslash case_file paths in battery_report.json).
[ASSUMED] citation_supportiveness judge will run on a frozen gate-tier model at temperature 0, n=3 majority.

failure_modes.description: Shape contract broken: adapter emits flat {metric: value}; promote.py reads candidate["scores"]. The claimed adapter->harness-gate CI chain either crashes on KeyError or never actually runs — AppealForge is gated by a parallel implementation and the harness gate has never gated its first real consumer.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: CI shows green 'eval_gate' while the harness promote gate has never executed against an AppealForge candidate.

failure_modes.description: NaN candidate score passes every comparison (breach False, regression False) and returns PASS on a hard gate.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: A corrupted score of NaN for pii_leakage_pass_rate promotes the release.

failure_modes.description: Registry values are string-matched with silent defaults: a direction typo inverts the gate (good scores WARN/BLOCK, bad scores PASS); a blocking typo or missing key silently downgrades hard to soft (default 'soft', exact 'hard' comparison).
failure_modes.user_visible_example: 'blocking: Hard' turns injection_resistance into a warning nobody reads.

failure_modes.description: No manifest check: candidate is compared to whatever baseline.json exists — including the bundled demo baseline (demo-local model, mock-lexical-judge, latency mean 0.0). Stale registry_hash/dataset_hash never blocks; the demo latency baseline of 0.0 hard-BLOCKs any real candidate whose p95 exceeds the 0.15 band.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: First real latency measurement (0.5s, well under the 2.0s threshold) is hard-blocked as a 'regression' vs a demo baseline of 0.0.

failure_modes.description: Missing baseline -> thresholds-only gating with a stdout warning; regression protection silently disappears (fail-open).
failure_modes.user_visible_example: Deleting or mis-pathing baseline.json removes regression gating and CI stays green.

failure_modes.description: WARN produces exit 0 = green check; soft warnings are visible only inside logs. 'Soft block -> human review' is a claim with no mechanism.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: Faithfulness WARN scrolls by in a green CI job; the PR merges unreviewed.

failure_modes.description: MockJudge-backed metrics (faithfulness, answer_relevancy) occupy soft gating rows indistinguishable from validated metrics; a lexical stand-in's scores can be mistaken for measurement.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: A stakeholder reads faithfulness=1.0 from the demo baseline as evidence of groundedness.

failure_modes.description: case_ok semantics duplicated in three places, protected only by a comment ('change all three in ONE commit'); drift silently changes what 'pass' means between the battery, the consumer gate, and the harness candidate.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: regression_gate treats receipt_verified=null as pass while the adapter treats it as fail; the two gates disagree and nobody notices.

failure_modes.description: XPASS is invisible to the gate: known_bad + empty expectations_failed counts as an ordinary pass inside battery_pass_rate; no xpass metric is emitted. Fixed defects never get promoted to hard expectations via the gate ledger — loudness lives only in run_battery stdout.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: adv_fm02_co50a's defect gets fixed; the case silently keeps xfail status forever and stops protecting anything.

failure_modes.description: Saturation with no alarm: battery at 25/25, recall@5 at 1.0 (n=15). Suites at ceiling with no failing known-bads and no recent deltas report zero information while looking like health.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: Six months of 100% green battery runs are cited as evidence of quality; they proved nothing after month one.

failure_modes.description: Cross-machine determinism is claimed ('byte-identical across runs and machines') but proven only within one host (runs_completed=2, Windows paths in the report). Band-0 exact-match gating rests on the unproven half.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: Linux CI produces different letter bytes (line endings, locale) than the Windows dev box; hash pins block or, worse, get regenerated per-platform.

failure_modes.description: Threshold and registry edits are governed by a comment ('never edit a threshold to turn a red gate green'), not by tooling; a red gate can be made green in one unreviewed diff.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: battery_pass_rate threshold quietly moves from 1.0 to 0.96 in a mixed refactor PR.

failure_modes.description: Doc-drift: header claims noise_band is 'overwritten by baseline.py with measured 2σ' — nothing overwrites it; compare.py takes max(registry, measured). The documented mechanism does not exist, inviting a future mis-edit.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: A maintainer 'restores' the overwrite behavior and clobbers hand-set registry bands.

failure_modes.description: Retrieval quality (recall@5=1.0, MRR=0.9, n=15) was measured once and is not regression-gated; contextual_recall (build-order 4) is not wired. n=15 means one regression = 6.7-point swing; recall@5 is saturated.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: A chunking change drops the right policy passage for 2 of 15 questions; no gate fires.

failure_modes.description: The pilot flywheel will ingest historical denials; no rule exists keeping real PHI out of repo-committed goldens, battery reports, or CI logs.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: A real member's denial text lands in cases/*.json and every CI log thereafter.

failure_modes.description: battery_pass_rate aggregates across scenarios (medical_necessity, not_covered, prior_auth_absent); a scenario-local regression can hide inside the aggregate, and per-scenario skew is never reported.
failure_modes.user_visible_example: All not_covered cases degrade while the aggregate stays high enough to pass a future loosened threshold.

taxonomy_ledger.mechanism: 24 L0 pytest tests incl. every compare.decide branch on hand-built fixtures; extend with IE-07 fixtures (NaN, enum typos, manifest mismatch, deleted baseline). 100% pass, hard block on merge.
Adapter contract fixtures (IE-03); registry loader schema tests (IE-06); AF retriever measured in isolation (recall@5, MRR vs ideal-passage goldens).
IE-01 full round-trip: battery_report fixture -> eval_adapter -> candidate.json -> promote.py, degraded and healthy variants, in CI.
AF 25-case battery with expectations sidecar; letters pinned by sha256; qa + receipt + determinism per case.
This entire run is T05; IE-01..IE-11 registry below; every hard gate must carry a demonstrated BLOCK proof before it counts.
CI is the application surface: WARN surfacing as PR annotation (IE-10); promote fail-closed on missing baseline in AF CI; error-path behavior of the gate under malformed inputs.
Lightweight now: nightly scheduled battery run + dual-platform hash comparison (IE-09) to catch environment drift breaking determinism. Full production monitoring activates at pilot traffic.
baseline/candidate/promote flow; letter sha256 pins; expectations sidecar; every delta is a diff to explain.

taxonomy_ledger.trigger: Activates when an RCM/appeals-qualified labeler (not the author) is signed to produce the 40 hand labels for judge validation and pilot letter review.

Activates when citation_supportiveness v1 reaches >=85% agreement or kappa>=0.6 vs 40 hand labels; until then all judge metrics are monitor_only/demo, never gates, and MockJudge rows are demoted (build step 2).
Activates when pilot produces (AF letter, actually-sent letter) pairs on the same historical denial: blinded pairwise preference, both orderings, by the T09 labeler.

taxonomy_ledger.mechanism: Hypothesis on adapter (emitted rates always in [0,1]; summary cross-check holds under generated rows) and on compare.decide (monotonicity: worsening any hard metric never flips BLOCK->PROMOTE; adding a passing metric never flips PROMOTE->BLOCK).
Consumer: adv_fm02/adv_t16a known_bad probes + benign controls in battery. Instrument: hostile report files (fabricated summaries, malformed rows, self-consistent lies) in IE-03.

To build at consumer: malformed-intake fixtures for AF (truncated denial fields, OCR-style noise, missing codes) — graceful degradation asserted, cliff-edge (>10-pt drop) flagged. Harness already carries malformed-input fixtures at T01.

Deterministic form: must_not_quote and citation checks are verbatim programmatic verification (architecture allows it — no LLM at runtime). Judge form (citation_supportiveness) covers only the subjective residue, under T10 rules.

recall@5/MRR vs ideal-passage goldens keyed by {question, ideal_passage}. Current n=15, recall@5 saturated at 1.0: expand to n>=50 with hard negatives, wire contextual_recall as a soft gate (build step 7).
Byte-identity proven within one host (runs_completed=2, sha256 pins). Band-0 exact-match gating is valid ONLY after IE-09 proves cross-platform identity (Linux CI hash == Windows dev hash).

AF has no LLM at runtime: latency/cost are monitor_only distributions. Harness demo perf rows retained but the demo baseline (latency mean 0.0) must never gate a real candidate — fixed by FM-04 manifest check.

Statutory/required letter elements and must_not_quote are ALWAYS programmatic (qa_status + expectations). PHI governance rule (FM-15): only synthetic/de-identified data in repo, real denials in access-controlled store referenced by hash, IE-11 PHI-pattern lint on datasets and reports.

Hostile-actor lens on: consumer-emitted report files (adapter type-checks + recompute-and-cross-check exists), CI secrets, registry supply chain and edit path (IE-06 lint), PHI in artifacts/logs (IE-11).

taxonomy_ledger.trigger: Activates when >=50 real payer outcomes exist from the pilot. No predictive score exists today; if one ships before then it prints 'unmeasured', never a confident number.

taxonomy_ledger.mechanism: Lightweight now: per-scenario pass reporting (medical_necessity / not_covered / prior_auth_absent), monitor_only. Payer/specialty strata analysis begins when the pilot corpus carries those fields.

taxonomy_ledger.justification: No autonomous side effects exist: deterministic engine, no LLM at runtime, no tool use, human-approval slot before any letter is sent. The gate's own side effect (BLOCK/PROMOTE of merges) is governed under T05. If send automation is ever added, T23 flips to applied with side-effect safety hard-blocked at L0 and L5.

No public benchmark exists for healthcare appeal-letter generation; the pilot look-back report on historical denials is the attempt to create one [strategic]. Any published claim carries a mandatory contamination caveat.

taxonomy_ledger.mechanism: Two claimed human steps, two measurements: (a) letter approval slot -> edit_rate, review_time_p50, rubber_stamp_flag, live from pilot day one; (b) 'soft WARN -> human review' -> WARN must be acknowledged via PR annotation (IE-10) or the claim is removed.
Pilot = side-by-side on historical denials vs letters the team actually sent; AF acts on nothing. Comparison and promotion criteria in shadow_plan.

This document is an adversarial architect pass and is INPUT to E-0, not E-0 itself (same account/context as the author). E-0 = independent fresh-context review of the post-fix bundle before any production-grade claim. Quarterly Goodhart audit; judge revalidation calendar starts at first validated judge; 5-case holdout rotation authored fresh-context quarterly.

metric_registry.name: citation_supportiveness
metric_registry.noise_band: 2σ over 5 baseline runs (judge is probabilistic even over deterministic letters)
metric_registry.blocking: monitor_only until T10 validation flips it to soft; never hard while unvalidated

metric_registry.name: harness_demo_rows_note
metric_registry.threshold_status: n/a — not a metric: process rule. faithfulness and answer_relevancy in the harness registry are demoted to monitor_only until T10 flips; MockJudge scores never appear in a gating row.

instrument_evals.method: Full round-trip in CI: battery_report fixture -> eval_adapter -> candidate.json -> promote.py. Healthy fixture must exit 0; degraded fixtures (one failing non-known_bad case; one nondeterministic case; one failed hard expectation) must each exit 1. First run disambiguates FM-01: as bundled, the flat adapter output vs candidate["scores"] cannot both be true.
instrument_evals.proves: The harness gate actually gates AppealForge; each hard AF metric has a demonstrated BLOCK.

instrument_evals.method: Existing demo-block (degraded pipeline -> exit 1). Extend: one fixture per hard registry row that trips ONLY that row.
instrument_evals.proves: Every hard metric, not just one, has been seen blocking.

instrument_evals.method: Field-by-field contract test on the full flag matrix (qa_status x deterministic x receipt_verified x known_bad x expectations_failed), incl. denominators (exclusion_adversarial_pass counts only non-known_bad expectation cases; 0/0 omits the metric -> gate BLOCKs on missing, verified), summary-mismatch, malformed rows, and self-consistent fabricated reports. Same matrix asserted against run_battery.case_ok and regression_gate (3-mirror agreement).
instrument_evals.proves: Adapter cannot be lied to and the three case_ok mirrors agree.

instrument_evals.method: Saturation alarm: 100% pass + 0 failing known_bads + 0 deltas across N consecutive runs -> report 'zero information' and open an un-saturation task.
instrument_evals.proves: A green suite that proves nothing is flagged, not celebrated.

instrument_evals.method: xpass_count emitted by adapter (known_bad + empty expectations_failed); seeded XPASS fixture must produce a visible WARN; test pins the loudness of run_battery's XPASS report itself.
instrument_evals.proves: Fixed defects surface at the gate and get promoted to hard expectations.

instrument_evals.method: Registry schema validator: required keys, enum-checked direction/blocking/level/method, no unknown keys, detects non-empty. CI lint: any registry/threshold diff without a linked justification fails.
instrument_evals.proves: A typo cannot invert or downgrade a gate; a threshold cannot quietly turn red green.

instrument_evals.method: Mutation suite: candidate score = NaN; metric dropped; direction flipped in a fixture registry; baseline deleted; each must produce BLOCK / red CI, never PASS.
instrument_evals.proves: judge_metric fails closed on garbage (kills FM-02, exercises FM-03/FM-05 fixes).

instrument_evals.method: Manifest-match check in promote.py: candidate carries manifest; registry_hash and dataset_hash must equal baseline's or the run BLOCKs with a 'stale baseline' reason. Test with the bundled demo baseline vs a real-manifest candidate.
instrument_evals.proves: No candidate is ever gated against a demo or stale baseline (kills FM-04).

instrument_evals.method: Dual-platform determinism job: full battery on Linux CI and on the Windows dev host; letter_sha256 sets must be identical.
instrument_evals.proves: T17's cross-machine claim; band-0 gating is legitimate.

instrument_evals.method: WARN surfacing: promote emits GitHub annotations / PR comment for every WARN; test asserts the annotation exists on a WARN fixture. Merge policy requires acknowledgment.
instrument_evals.proves: Soft gates reach a human; 'human review' of WARNs is real (FM-06, T25).

instrument_evals.method: PHI-pattern lint (names, DOB, member-ID shapes) over cases/, out_battery/, and CI logs; real-denial data lives outside the repo, referenced by hash.
instrument_evals.proves: The pilot flywheel cannot leak PHI into version control (FM-15).

datasets.known_bad_convention: xfail: probes of unfixed defects fail loudly but non-blocking; XPASS is loudly reported AND emitted as xpass_count; promoted to hard when the fix lands. Composition counts [ASSUMED] from report head + registry comments.
datasets.statistical_caveat: n=25: one case = 4.0 points; the 1.0 hard threshold is exact-match over a small deterministic set, valid only because T17 holds. Holdout = 5 rotating cases authored fresh-context quarterly (to_build).
datasets.refresh: every new pilot defect becomes a case (flywheel); holdout rotated quarterly

datasets.known_bad_convention: hard negatives added at expansion (distractor policies from wrong payers/years)
datasets.statistical_caveat: n=15: one miss = 6.7 points; recall@5=1.0 is saturated and carries near-zero information. Expand to n>=50 before contextual_recall gates anything (build step 7). Composition [ASSUMED].
datasets.refresh: with every corpus update; scheduled reverification when payer policies change

datasets.statistical_caveat: n=40: kappa CI is wide; >=85% agreement on 30 dev + confirmation on 10 holdout is a floor, not proof. Revalidate quarterly on a frozen anchor set.
Demo-only: its baseline (mock judge, latency 0.0) must never gate a real candidate — enforced by IE-08 manifest check.

criteria: Every claim in the letter that is attributed to a cited source is actually supported by the quoted/referenced passage (binary per claim; verdict PASS only if zero UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED units).

validation_plan.labeler: RCM/appeals specialist, not the system author
validation_plan.labeler_qualification: Must judge clinical/coverage validity of support, not argumentative valence — a persuasive-sounding but unsupported citation is a FAIL; author sessions and non-domain labelers disqualified.

hard_block: any registry metric missing from candidate
NaN or non-numeric score once IE-07 lands
soft_block: xpass_count > 0 (WARN drives promotion of the fixed case to hard)
citation_supportiveness < 0.95 [PROVISIONAL] — monitor_only until T10 validation, soft after
ci_triggers: every PR touching harness, AF pipeline, registry, cases, or judges: L0 + IE suite + full battery + adapter + promote
nightly: full battery + IE-09 dual-platform hash + IE-04 saturation check

online_plan.tracing: Pre-pilot: none (no traffic). At pilot: PII-masked tracing of intake -> retrieval -> letter -> reviewer decision; raw denials stay in the access-controlled store, traces reference by hash.
online_plan.sampling: 100% at pilot volume [ASSUMED <=100 letters/month]; stratify by scenario and payer once fields exist.
online_metrics: must_not_quote / statutory-element checks (reference-free, same code as offline)
citation_supportiveness (same frozen judge version as offline, once validated)
online_plan.flywheel_ritual: Weekly: read every pilot letter alongside reviewer edits; every reviewer edit or rejection becomes a labeled trace; new failure mode -> new battery case (dev) or holdout candidate; reproduced offline before the fix; fix regression-protected by the pinned case.

shadow_plan.incumbent: Letters the team actually sent on the same historical denials (side-by-side; AF acts on nothing).
comparison_metrics: blinded pairwise preference (T11), both orderings, T09 labeler
edit_rate on AF letters vs incumbent
S1 defect count (unsupported citation, statutory element missing, wrong member/claim facts)
shadow_plan.promotion_criteria: Out of shadow only when: pairwise preference >= parity on n>=30 pairs [ASSUMED], zero S1 defects across the shadow set, T25 metrics live and showing real review, and E-0 fresh-context review completed.

scores: none predictive today; if an appeal-success or prioritization score is ever added it enters here
calibration_plan.outcome_data_needed: >=50 real payer decisions on pilot appeals

hitl_process_plan.thresholds: [PROVISIONAL] rubber_stamp_flag: >=90% of approvals with zero edits AND review_time < 30s -> the 'human approval' claim is flagged as unsupported and removed from any pitch until remediated. Instrument-level: every CI WARN requires an acknowledgment (IE-10).

meta_eval_plan.fresh_context_review: E-0: independent fresh-context session receives the post-fix reviewer bundle (source, registries, baseline, battery report, this spec) with an adversarial reviewer prompt; author sessions disqualified — this document is input to E-0, not E-0. Scheduled BEFORE any production-grade claim and before pilot letters are shown to a customer.
meta_eval_plan.goodhart_audit: Quarterly: has battery_pass_rate become a target (cases authored to pass the engine rather than represent denials)? Rotate the 5-case holdout, keep 2 battery expectations unannounced to the implementation session, retire saturated cases flagged by IE-04.

eval_cost_estimate.note: [ASSUMED] judge at 25 cases x 3 runs x ~3k tokens on a gate-tier model ~ $1/suite; $0 today (MockJudge/lexical + deterministic checks are free); ~$20/month at pilot for judge triage on 100% of letters.

build_order.what: IE-01 round-trip in CI; resolve FM-01: adapter wraps output as {"manifest": ..., "scores": {...}} (or promote accepts both, versioned), and determine whether AF's regression_gate or promote.py has actually been gating — retire the discrepancy.
build_order.exit_criteria: CI job: healthy fixture -> exit 0; each degraded fixture -> exit 1; one gate implementation is authoritative.

build_order.what: Fail-closed hardening: NaN/non-numeric -> BLOCK; IE-06 registry schema lint (enum direction/blocking); IE-08 manifest match; missing baseline -> fail-closed in AF CI; demote MockJudge-backed rows to monitor_only.
build_order.exit_criteria: IE-07 mutation suite: every mutation goes red; L0 count grows accordingly; demo baseline can no longer gate a real candidate.

build_order.what: Kill the 3-mirror: regression_gate becomes a thin wrapper over compare.decide (or is deleted); IE-03 flag-matrix contract test asserts remaining mirrors agree.
build_order.exit_criteria: One decide() implementation; matrix test green; a seeded semantic drift in a mirror goes red.

build_order.what: Metrics hygiene at the adapter: emit xpass_count (IE-05) and scenario_pass_min; IE-04 saturation alarm wired to nightly run.
build_order.exit_criteria: Seeded XPASS fixture -> visible WARN; nightly report prints 'zero information' on a saturated fixture suite.

build_order.what: WARN surfacing + threshold governance: promote emits PR annotations for WARNs (IE-10); registry-diff-requires-justification lint live.
build_order.exit_criteria: Demo PR shows WARN annotation; unjustified threshold edit fails CI.

build_order.what: IE-09 dual-platform determinism proof (Linux CI vs Windows dev hashes); IE-11 PHI lint before any historical denial enters the flywheel.
build_order.exit_criteria: Hash-equality job green (or finding filed and T17 band-0 claim suspended); PHI lint blocks a seeded pattern.

build_order.what: Retrieval un-saturation: expand goldens 15 -> >=50 with hard negatives; wire contextual_recall as soft; baseline it.
build_order.exit_criteria: recall metrics off the ceiling or ceiling justified; contextual_recall gating soft with a measured baseline.

build_order.what: citation_supportiveness v1: instantiate judge template, 40 hand labels by qualified RCM labeler, kappa>=0.6, freeze + version; flips T10, retires MockJudge from all gating paths.
build_order.exit_criteria: Agreement target met on dev and confirmed on 10-label holdout; judge row moves monitor_only -> soft; revalidation calendar entry created.

build_order.what: E-0 fresh-context meta-review of the post-fix bundle; then pilot shadow (T26) with T25 metrics live from letter one.
build_order.exit_criteria: Independent review filed with zero unaddressed S1 findings; shadow running; only then instantiate this prompt on the next external project.
